name: ctce_entropy
description: Diagnostic for CTCE on market_s2 (L-02): does the entropy bonus, unclipped while PPO clips one joint ratio over all 13 agents, drive CTCE's rising log std? The same setup as market_s2 with 8 env runners: the joint entropy at 0.01 (as market_s2, before RP-3a), at 0.01 / 13 (each agent's part as in DTDE, the default since RP-3a) and 0. entropy_coeff is per agent and CTCE divides it by the 13 agents, so 0.13 gives the joint 0.01. Logs the clip fraction.
